In this section we provide links to the research literature describing the implementation of algorithms in software for the evaluation of functions described in this chapter. Included also are links to software provided by the auther. For other software see the Software Index.

§29.22(i) Lamé Functions

ⓘ
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/29.22.i
See also:
Annotations for §29.22 and Ch.29

The following Maple programs were provided by the author.

LA1: Eigenvalues for Lamé functions.

LA2: Lamé functions.

LA5: Coefficients τj of the asymptotic expansions for the eigenvalues of the Lamé functions; see §29.7(i).

Precision in LA1 and LA2 is adjustable. Program LA5 uses symbolic algebra.

§29.22(ii) Lamé Polynomials

ⓘ
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/29.22.ii
See also:
Annotations for §29.22 and Ch.29

The following Maple programs were provided by the author.

LA3: Eigenvalues for Lamé polynomials.

LA4: Lamé polynomials.

Precision in LA3 and LA4 is adjustable.

See also Jansen (1977).
